rules.label: you
rules.text: Brand voice rule: write in second person (you, your) and use contractions (you're, it's, we'll).

rules.label: no ! or emoji
rules.text: Brand voice rule: never use exclamation points or emoji.

rules.label: banned words
rules.text: Banned words, in any form: excited, thrilled, streamline, simplify, seamless, effortless, unlock, game-changer.

rules.label: short
rules.text: Brand voice rule: sentences under 20 words; no more than one adjective before a noun.

rules.label: kitchen
rules.text: Approved metaphor family: the kitchen (prep, mise en place, a calm service). Do not use sports or war metaphors.

rules.label: sign-off
rules.text: Sign-off rule: every email ends with '- The Tallyleaf kitchen' and no other sign-off.

identity: Brand identity: Tallyleaf makes invoicing and bookkeeping software for independent restaurants and cafes.
Brand audience: owner-operators who close the books after service, usually after 11pm.
Product fact: Recurring invoices launch on 2026-10-20; suppliers get the same invoice every week without retyping.
Product fact: Tallyleaf syncs with three POS systems: Toast, Square and Lightspeed.
